purpose: Authorize exactly one future claim-bound development execution of the frozen EXP-G1 nested CatBoost screen, only after the additive official compiler and wrapper pass two-root official-shaped synthetic acceptance at exact integrated source hashes.
hypothesis: The exact twelve-configuration, three-seed nested screen materially improves the immutable fixed-MapLight family-safe development baseline while satisfying every preregistered global, uncertainty, consistency, and endpoint-harm gate.
occam_boundary: Execute the already frozen G2-3A experiment once. Do not add a feature, configuration, seed, fit, metric, threshold, endpoint-specific choice, baseline refit, retry, repair, resume, or exploratory branch.

accepted_implementation.extension_rule: The future official compiler and attempt wrapper must be additive and must reuse the accepted G1 runner's frozen identities, arithmetic, selector, scorer, bootstrap, accounting, cleanup, and terminal mechanics without changing a scientific choice. Their exact sources and two-root acceptance receipt must be integrated and placed into the consumed claim before any development capability opens.

claim_contract.unconsumed_placeholders: Every future_* field is null in the tracked template. Consumption derives one private canonical claim without changing a frozen field and fills the four nulls with exact reviewed integrated receipts.
claim_contract.consumption: Atomic no-replace creation of the fixed private attempt root consumes the sole claim. The private consumed claim and its hash are retained read-only; the tracked template never mutates. A crash, failure, underpowered terminal, rejection, or acceptance remains consumed.
claim_contract.precondition: Claim consumption is forbidden until the exact official-shaped synthetic acceptance proves two fresh roots byte-identical, full 8,820-stage topology per root, exact locked-runtime constructor probes, least-privilege capabilities, resource bounds, cleanup, failure semantics, and zero official or forbidden operations.

official_inputs.read_boundary: This milestone authenticates receipt strings only. It does not parse, copy, link, list row identities from, or otherwise open an official development or baseline row-level file. A consumed claim is required before a future wrapper may open the fixed roots.

execution.selection_rule: For each repeat, outer fold, and endpoint, select lower pooled-inner tutorial ST-RAE, then lower component-macro MAE, then lexicographically lower configuration_id; refit only the selected configuration under all three seeds.
execution.prediction_freeze: All candidate outer predictions and the immutable paired baseline join must freeze before the outer scorer may resolve development truth or compute a metric.
execution.fit_failure: A missing, extra, duplicate, failed, nonfinite, drifted, or interrupted model identity fails the entire consumed attempt. Unused parent fit capacity cannot fund repair or replacement.

development_acceptance.name_boundary: The tutorial metric is a pinned local development diagnostic, not a verified live-backend official score.
development_acceptance.logic: All five gates are conjunctive. Equality passes numeric minimum or maximum gates except the paired upper 95% bound, which must be strictly below zero; favorable cells require strictly lower candidate component-macro MAE.
development_acceptance.pass: Publish G2_3_G1_ACCEPTED and allow only a later separate EXP-G2 contract.
development_acceptance.clean_rejection: Publish G2_3_G1_REJECTED, retain fixed MapLight, and permanently stop EXP-G1 without grid expansion or outcome-driven repair.

runtime_and_resources.resource_rule: No adaptive concurrency. The wrapper runs one CatBoost fit at a time with the frozen sixteen-thread constructor, records monotonic wall and process resource telemetry outside authoritative terminals, and fails closed on any ceiling breach.

terminal_contract.publication: Only aggregate receipts, counts, selected configuration IDs, metrics, resources, accounting, authority, and decision may enter Git. Targets, bounds, structures, predictions, residuals, and component membership remain private.
terminal_contract.cleanup: Before terminal publication remove target/model capabilities, writable model state, temporary feature links or copies, CatBoost state, and staging roots. Retain only the read-only consumed claim, receipt, and status-specific terminal. Cleanup failure changes any scientific status to G2_3_G1_FAILED.
terminal_contract.failure: Any receipt, runtime, family, capability, identity, topology, parameter, prediction-freeze, paired-join, metric, bootstrap, accounting, resource, cleanup, or publication defect is terminal with no retry, resume, move, overwrite, or outcome-driven repair.

forbidden.must_never_open: Confirmatory truth, historical R3C row-level artifacts, blinded-test chemistry or predictions, TDI, external records, submission state, live official metric, leaderboard, and upload capability remain outside EXP-G1 under every terminal.

targeted_failure_modes: V1/V2 molecule, exact-duplicate, or component-family leakage
V3 in-fold or outer-outcome configuration, seed, metric, or threshold selection
V4 source, feature, fold, target, baseline, runtime, parameter, seed, or implementation drift
V6 representing the tutorial diagnostic as a live official score
C6 MapLight feature-order or resolved-CatBoost-parameter drift
P5 partial publication, retry, resume, move, overwrite, fit reuse, or nondeterminism
P6 confirmatory, historical-row, blinded-test, TDI, external, submission, metric, leaderboard, or upload contamination
next_gate: Implement only the additive G2-3C official capability compiler, attempt wrapper, and two-root official-shaped synthetic driver. Bind their exact source hashes in a reviewed synthetic acceptance receipt while every official and forbidden counter remains zero. Do not consume the claim or open development inputs in that milestone.
